notes.subject: בעברי פי פחת
notes.rationale: 'at the sides/passages of the pit's mouth' — KJV 'sides of the hole's mouth' vs ASV 'over the mouth of the abyss'; rendered as 'on the edge of the pit's mouth'

notes.subject: כיונה תקנן
notes.rationale: dove nesting: image of Moab fleeing to the cliffs like a timid dove; kept literal

notes.subject: to Moab
notes.rationale: imperatives address the inhabitants of Moab directly

notes.subject: עזבו...ושכנו
notes.rationale: the verse summons Moab's dwellers to abandon the cities and dwell in the rock

translation: Aw sigiminw Moab, aw bilingaw bɔ, aw ka sigi selɛ na, aw ka kɛ lafolo ye min bɛ a ka denso da jon da bugulila.
